{{Quote|And guess who gets to clean it up? Old Jan, that's right.|Maintenance Logs of Jan Stakross, speaking of the T-16 skyhopper|<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] "Mynock" databank entry}}</ref>}}
[[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] '''Jan Stakross''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|being]] who warned a group of individuals, pointing to one named [[Antilles (Agarrees Shipyard Township)|Antilles]] in particular, not to take a [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] down to the [[Agarrees Shipyard Township]], for the township was infested with [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]],<ref name="TFUII" /> creatures that [[Diet/Legends|fed]] on power cabling.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Stakross knew that despite the warnings, [[Unidentified joyrider|one]] of the beings was taking the [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhopper]] down to the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] for a joyride. The T-16 became infested with mynocks, and nearly every bit of cabling had bite marks on it from the creatures.<ref name="TFUII" />

Although they did not like it, the corporal was the one who had to clean up the skyhopper. After cleaning the T-16 and writing about the cleanup in the [[Maintenance Log]]s, they expressed frustration with the work and adamantly pleaded with the group of individuals to stay away from the shipyard where the mynocks were. In the logs, Stakross referred to themselves as "old."<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jan Stakross was mentioned in the mynock databank entry of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]]. The databank was exclusive to the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] console versions of the game.<ref name="TFUII" />
